annotation.bound_parties_text: The bill criminalizes importing or transporting child sex dolls and punishes "whoever knowingly" buys, sells, delivers, distributes or possesses them.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: ‘‘Whoever knowingly— ‘‘(1) buys, sells, delivers, or distributes in interstate or foreign commerce any child sex doll,
annotation.robot_provision_quote: the term ‘child sex doll’ means an anatomically correct doll, mannequin, or robot, with the features of, or with features that resemble those of, a minor
